name: Oma
source:
A girl who sticks close by to Dr. Injouji. She is not good at communication and she struggles to even look at other people other than Dr. Injouji.

Since she doesn't speak much, she often uses gestures to communicate.

[Translation from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/sentou/]Official Site[/url]]
